description: This file defines a Java interface named 'CommandSerializer' responsible for serializing commands into another format, specifically JSON, as indicated by the method 'serializeCommandToJson'. It serves as a contract for implementing classes that handle command serialization within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: CommandSerializer
classes.description: Interface for serializing commands into another format, with a method to serialize a command object into JSON.

methods.name: serializeCommandToJson
methods.description: Converts a command object into its JSON string representation.
